journey.title: Confirm a notification actually arrived
journey.purpose: The owner can answer, without asking anyone, whether something they were promised would reach them actually reached them — and when it did not, why not and what to do about it. This is the journey the scenario exists for; the predecessor implementation reported healthy for ten months while failing it.

steps.intent: Scan recent notifications newest-first and see each one's delivery state without opening anything.
Recognise a failed delivery from its row alone, including which device it was for and the reason it failed.
Open one notification and see every attempt made for it, on which channel, by which machine, and why routing chose that channel.
Retry a failed delivery, or follow the stated remedy when retrying cannot help because the address is wrong.
